title: torch.compile graph break with compile-inclusive shape schedule
authoring_note: This anchor measures graph-break overhead and first-encounter shape specialization on a one-block, eight-shape schedule. The baseline has an .item()-dependent graph break with dynamic=False; the oracle removes the break and buckets the registered shapes into one fixed graph. The primary metric is the end-to-end registered schedule, including first compilation.
